card.name: Digits in years inside news and government text
card.fires_on: Mostly the digit inside a year (2006, 1999, 2005) in news, diplomatic or human-rights text. It also fires on a few other spots, such as 'President' before a head of state's name and words inside 'Cruel, Inhuman, or Degrading'.

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: A digit within a four-digit year in a dated news or government item.

modes.label: Political and rights phrases
modes.description: Words in titles or fixed phrases from government and human-rights reports.
